properties.name: script-scheduler.enabled
properties.description: Whether the script scheduler is enabled.

properties.name: script-scheduler.thread-pool-size
properties.description: The size of the thread pool used for executing scripts.

properties.name: script-scheduler.shutdown-timeout-seconds
properties.description: The timeout in seconds to wait for running scripts to complete on shutdown.

properties.name: script-scheduler.default-timeout-seconds
properties.description: Global default timeout for all scripts in seconds. Can be overridden per script.

properties.name: script-scheduler.default-interpreter
properties.description: Global default interpreter for all scripts. Can be overridden per script.

properties.name: script-scheduler.default-log-output
properties.description: Whether to log script output by default. Can be overridden per script.
